authority.identity: For Q(u,r)=C+r R(u), the admitted parameters have R in {(Nx,Ny), turn*perp(Nx,Ny), (-Nx,-Ny)}. Therefore Q(u,r')=Q(u,r)+(r'-r)R exactly, including signed-radius center crossings.
